summary: Comprehensive smoke test of Botree Proposal Tracker: full 5-stage approval workflow, reject/resubmit flow, admin user management, and UI theme all verified end-to-end on public URL.
passed: Login for all 6 roles (Admin/Sales/CGO/Finance/Legal/CFO) returns 200 with session cookie
GET /api/proposals returns 200 (empty [] initially -> orphan-proposal 500 bug is fixed)
GET /api/users returns full user list for Admin
Sales upload file (POST /api/proposals/upload) -> proposal create (POST /api/proposals) -> status=sales_submitted, stage=1
CGO approve -> finance_review; Finance approve -> legal_review; Legal approve -> cfo_review; CFO approve -> approved (stage=5, history=5 entries)
Reject flow: CGO reject -> status=needs_revision, stage=0
Sales edit rejected proposal (PUT /api/proposals/{id}) -> resubmitted, status=sales_submitted, stage=1
File download GET /api/files/{id} returns 200 with file bytes
Admin create user (POST /api/users) -> 200; change role (PUT /api/users/{id}/role?role=Finance) -> 200; delete user (DELETE /api/users/{id}) -> 200
Login page loads with Botree branding and pink->purple gradient (rgb(247,37,133) -> rgb(114,9,183))
Sales login -> redirects to /dashboard, shows Total=2 / Pending=1 / Approved=1 counters
Sidebar uses pink-purple gradient; Dashboard, Pending, Approved, New Proposal, Sign Out nav all present
Created proposals from API tests visible in UI (Reject Test v2 = Sales Submitted, Test Proposal T1 = Approved)
No console errors on dashboard (only benign 401 on initial /auth/me before login)

failed.issue: PUT /api/users/{id}/role expects `role` as query parameter, not JSON body. First attempt with JSON body returned 422. Works when called as ?role=Finance.

action_items: Verify the frontend Admin UI calls PUT /users/{id}/role with role as a query param (not JSON body); if it currently sends JSON, update it. Not a blocker for first finish.
